title: HB3004 (2017-2018 Regular): Improving security in schools and the safety of students.

other_topics: public-safety-approach: Secs. 1-3 — school emergency-response grants, an anonymous 'students protecting students' tip program run by the attorney general, and school education about it (not about guns)

provenance.fetched_by: Open States public data converted to LegiScan layout (gun-policy Stage 5, Washington); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Washington Legislature text (Introduced, https://lawfilesext.leg.wa.gov/Biennium/2017-18/Htm/Bills/House%20Bills/3004.htm, downloaded directly)
provenance.note: Introduced version. Large file read by marks. Sec. 10 strikes '(twenty-five)' and inserts 'fifty' for three license fees (pistol, other firearm, ammunition). Sec. 13 (RCW 36.28A.420) adds grant uses for local background checks. Sec. 4 adds public-records exemptions for the tip program.

Sec. 5 (RCW 9.41.010): (29) "Semiautomatic rifle or shotgun with tactical features" means:
Sec. 5 (RCW 9.41.010): (b) A semiautomatic, centerfire, or rimfire rifle with a fixed magazine, that has the capacity to accept more than ten rounds of ammunition;
Sec. 5 (RCW 9.41.010): (c) A semiautomatic, centerfire, or rimfire rifle that has an overall length of less than thirty inches;
Sec. 6 (RCW 9.41.090): (1) In addition to the other requirements of this chapter, no dealer may deliver a pistol or semiautomatic rifle or shotgun with tactical features to the purchaser thereof until:
Sec. 11 (RCW 9.41.113): (4) No person may sell or transfer a semiautomatic rifle or shotgun with tactical features to a person under twenty-one years of age.
Sec. 14 (RCW 9.41.240): (1) A person under twenty-one years of age may not purchase a pistol pursuant to Title 18 U.S.C. Sec. 922(b)(1) or a semiautomatic rifle or shotgun with tactical features pursuant to RCW 9.41.113.
Sec. 14 (RCW 9.41.240): (2) Unless an exception under RCW 9.41.042, 9.41.050, or 9.41.060 applies, a person at least eighteen years of age, but less than twenty-one years of age, may possess a pistol or semiautomatic rifle or shotgun with tactical features only:
Sec. 10 (RCW 9.41.110): (c) The license fee for pistols or semiautomatic rifles or shotguns with tactical features shall be one hundred fifty dollars.
Sec. 12 (RCW 9.41.124): Residents of a state other than Washington may purchase rifles and shotguns, except those firearms defined as semiautomatic rifles or shotguns with tactical features, in Washington:
